name: amateo-video-promo
description: Video promotionnelle 60 s (Remotion) — projet isole a la racine du depot, zero dependance avec frontend/ ou landing/ (meme logique d'isolement que landing/).

scripts.render: node scripts/stage-media.cjs && remotion render src/index.ts AmateoPromo out/amateo-promo-60s.mp4
scripts.draft: node scripts/stage-media.cjs && remotion render src/index.ts AmateoPromo out/draft-720p.mp4 --scale=0.6666666666666666
scripts.still: node scripts/stage-media.cjs && remotion still src/index.ts AmateoPromo out/stills/plan01.png --frame=200
